selectionStatus: Exploratory follow-up chosen AFTER inspecting v7.7 falling-regime positive effects
calendar: 2020-01 to 2026-09; only the exact 623 symbol-months admitted in immutable v7.7
eventDefinition: Unchanged first eligible EARLY_CANDIDATE_SHADOW LONG per UTC day and sweptLowReclaimed from v7.7. No event or directional reclassification.
primaryOutcome: Sweep minus non-Sweep average FUTURES close-to-close percent change in 1h (4 closed 15m), 2h (8), 4h (16), AFTER closed observation bar. Differences in percentage points, not trading P&L.
comparisonMethod: Within same symbol, calendar month and pre-event regime group. Discard a symbol-month cell only when Sweep or non-Sweep comparison group is empty. Equal events are grouped using event-count-weighted means, as in v7.7.
past24hRegime: DOWN when close at event candle vs close 96 15-minute candles earlier is strictly below -1.0%. UP >1% and SIDE otherwise.
severity: Only DOWN cases: MILD when -3% < trailing24h return < -1%; DEEP when trailing24h return <= -3%; exactly -1% excluded from DOWN.
volume: Current FULLY CLOSED event 15-minute base-volume divided by median base-volume of PREVIOUS 96 closed 15-minute bars (excluding current candle). HIGH when >=1.50; NORMAL otherwise. No future volume.
flow: Current FULLY CLOSED 15-minute taker BUY base volume / total base volume. BUY_DOMINANT when >=0.55; otherwise OTHER. If zero candle volume, mark metric missing, never impute.
centralHypothesis: Within DOWN_ALL, the added forward return for Sweep remains >0 across both 2020-2023 and 2024-2026, more than a merely historical mean.
diagnostics: For each of six frozen conditions: pooled and each epoch separately with group counts
Per-asset per-horizon per-year sign and group counts
Absolute Sweep positive-return rate versus non-Sweep as descriptive outcome
Sweep-minus-control within symbol and month, with regime/condition exactly matched
inferentialFamily: Only DOWN_ALL (8 assets times 3 horizons = 24 comparisons) receives synchronized 27-quarter (BTC/ETH/all alts) cluster bootstrap 12000 draws and max-|t| familywise two-sided approximate 95% intervals. Other conditions are diagnostics, not confirmatory statistical tests.
decisionRule: No trade promotion. Mark candidate for PROSPECTIVE test only when DOWN_ALL effect positive in both eras, positive in >=5 of 7 available calendar years, and the 24-test simultaneous 95% lower bound >0. Otherwise unstable/inconclusive.
readiness: If a condition has less than 30 Sweep events OR 30 nonsweep events in new era, mark LOW_SUPPORT; show actual counts, do not hide.
failClosed: SHA-256 v7.7 combined report and per-asset events verified
Reopen original R2 5m archives, matching original v7.7 historical event returns 1/2/4h to abs 1e-9 pct points
Verify 24h history and complete UTC source month, no substitute or dropped source-month
Persist versioned v7.8 source rows and R2 manifest, SHA readback
If any asset source fails no combined success
limitations: v7.8 condition chosen after studying v7.7 — no unused blind holdout remains within these months
2020-2023 versus 2024-2026 is a contextual split, NOT a randomized estimate of ETF/institutional impact
Order-flow proxy uses Binance taker-buy ratio, no authenticated order-book, OI, funding or marketwide liquidity data
Comparisons are observational and have regime/volume selection bias; medians/ratios not proven execution features
Fixed first LONG per day windows; price outcome after observation candle may be unattainable at exact close
Commissions, spreads, slippage, funding and full live Detector parity are not established
No order placement, live detector changes, NAV, reserve, Futures, P&L, capital or trading limits
